TECHNOLOGY AND INNOVATION COMMISSION AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, MARCH 27, 2024
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  THE BEACH CONFERENCE ROOM, 2ND FLOOR, 3:30 PM

Lisa Mae Brunson, Chair  Javier Ortiz, Commissioner
Jonathan de Armas, Vice Chair  Emily Woodman-Nance, Commissioner
Nicole Callihan, Commissioner

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO EMAIL COMMENTS TO
  ALEJANDRA.GARCIA@LONGBEACH.GOV

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-52712  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Technology and Innovation
  Commission meeting of Wednesday, February 28, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  24-52713  Recommendation to receive and file Director’s Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  24-52714  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation on TID26, the Technology and
  Innovation Department's short-term IT strategic planning effort.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  24-52715  Recommendation to review the Technology and Innovation Commission’s 2024
  topics.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  24-52716  Recommendation to receive and file report(s) from current Ad Hoc Committees,
  including the Data Privacy Ad Hoc Committee and the Generative AI Ad Hoc
  Committee.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  24-52717  Recommendation to establish the TID26 Strategic Planning Ad Hoc Committee and
  consider the establishment of additional Ad Hoc Committees and/or dissolution of
  existing Ad Hoc Committees.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Technology and Innovation Commission on non-agenda items. Each
speaker is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Kyle Smith, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior
to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact Alejandra Garcia (562) 570-6455 or
alejandra.garcia@longbeach.gov.
